QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_15

question.text: Audit of which of the following PPM sections is OPTIONAL (not mandatory) under the annual PPM compliance audit framework for Cat I/II AIFs?

answer.text: Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory/Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses, and Glossary and Terms.
Management fees charged for each class of units.
Capital commitments received and drawdowns made during the year.

explanation.text: The Logic: The PPM audit framework specifically carves out five OPTIONAL sections: Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory and Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses, and Glossary and Terms. All other PPM sections remain within the mandatory audit scope. The Trap: Investment strategy implementation, capital commitments and drawdowns during the year, and management fees charged for each class of units are explicitly listed in the workbook as part of the mandatory audit scope, not the optional carve-out. Note: The optional vs mandatory split is set out on the pages dealing with the annual PPM compliance audit; the optional list is the one to memorise verbatim, since every other PPM section defaults to mandatory.
